pages.name: Identity and context
pages.title: People, play and a shared place
pages.subtitle: An evidence-based reference with local applications; no organization approval is implied.

elements.text: The name connects passion and the game. Its dot represents a meeting point; the intentionally imperfect pitch reflects grassroots spaces made by people.
Describe communities as active partners and local leaders. Keep the complete logo and its custom lettering intact.
Identity context: official About and FAQ. Visual styling: observed website. Page layouts: local Brandkit proposals.

pages.name: Logo artwork
pages.title: Preserve the source artwork
pages.subtitle: Thirteen original vector paths; a red flag retained in both treatments.

elements.text: PDF source treatment: white and red
The vector comes from love.fútbol’s 2025 guide published by U.S. Soccer. A single translation normalizes the canvas; the original paths and proportions remain intact.
No isolated pitch, retyped wordmark, arbitrary recolours or invented favicon is generated. Official minimum size and numeric clear space remain unverified.

pages.name: Digital palette
pages.title: Colours observed on the website
pages.subtitle: Use accents as surfaces and emphasis; keep small text dark and readable.

elements.text: Supporting values: charcoal #1D1D1B, dark-green body text #081913 and mobile-menu amber #F5A300. The logo uses black/white with source flag red #ED1C24.
White text on green, terracotta or light green does not reach 4.5:1. These templates use charcoal text on those accents. Verify the final pair and type size in Colour.
No official Pantone or CMYK recipes were found. Website colours are observations, not print specifications.

pages.name: Typography
pages.title: Keep the type roles distinct
pages.subtitle: Original font files under the SIL Open Font License are included.

elements.text: Observed on the Projects page’s large country headings. Use for short display copy; this kit does not claim it is the only headline typeface.
Observed body, navigation and supporting type. Regular and Bold set these applications; Italic is an additional document-emphasis choice.
Other site rules declare DK Brush Crush for H1 and Acumin Pro Condensed for H3. Those commercial font files are not bundled. The 2024 and 2025 reports use other type combinations.
The logo’s custom wordmark is vector artwork. Never replace it with Bahianita, Red Hat Text or typed letters.

pages.name: Language and voice
pages.title: Write with community agency
pages.subtitle: Editorial recommendations derived from the official mission, FAQ and culture resources.

elements.text: Use love.fútbol in running copy: lower case, a dot, and an accented ú. Use lovefutbol only where URLs or file identifiers require it.
Name local leaders, shared decisions and ongoing responsibilities. Make the community’s role visible in the story.
Give the measure, period, geography and source. Do not turn illustrative project placeholders into reported achievements.
Retain people’s names and place names accurately. Review translations locally. Use consented photography and meaningful captions.

pages.subtitle: Local layouts informed by the website; not recovered official stationery.

elements.text: Letter and A4 stationery and project briefs. Use the Documents editor for flowing reports, decision briefs and brand references with editable Word output.
Add verified local information and sources. The 48 mm document logo, 8 mm reserved space and 20 mm margins are local defaults, not published brand rules.

pages.name: Presentation and digital
pages.title: Carry the same identity into each format
pages.subtitle: Editable slide, social and email applications with explicit placeholders.

elements.text: Four slide layouts support an opening, section break, content and evidence. Social layouts and email signatures keep contact and project information editable.
Use approved project photography and captions. Partner logos and endorsements need separate confirmation.

pages.title: Keep evidence with the assets
pages.subtitle: The research record separates published facts, observed implementations and local choices.

elements.text: Original vector paths and source PDF. Official website logo reference. Sanitized Projects-page evidence. Source URLs and hashes. Original open-licence font files.
A current official brand standards manual; minimum sizes; numeric clear space; print recipes; partner lockup rules; official stationery and motion guidance.
Research: docs/RESEARCH.md. Source index: reference/sources.json. Logo extraction and comparison: reference/logo-extraction.json. Font origins: fonts/source-manifest.json.
Rebuild with npm run make:lovefutbol. Update source evidence before changing a claimed brand rule. Public availability does not grant blanket permission for trademarks or photography.
